component.name: LFM App
component.summary: All your LFM essentials in one app

description.p: The official desktop app for Low Fuel Motorsport (LFM). Free essentials for every driver; LFM Plus unlocks advanced racing tools and livery workflows.

ul.li: Race Hub: browse LMU daily, weekly and special events, upcoming sessions, track info and requirements
AC Sync: install required Assetto Corsa mods with one click and keep selected series content updated automatically
AC Sync history, so you know what changed
Inbox with news, stream updates and changelogs
Sign up and manage race entries from the app, including car and livery choice where supported
Upload personal and team liveries and keep your local ACC liveries in sync
Upcoming races drawer, next race widget and race notifications

description.p: Sign in with Steam to get started. The games run through Steam Play (Proton); the app finds their folders automatically. Voice chat and the in-game overlay are not available on Linux yet.

screenshot.caption: Home hub with quick access to the tools you need
AC Sync keeps mods installed, updated and ready
